name: Casa de Campo Resort & Villas
insider_take: This legendary Dominican Republic resort sits on 7,000 acres of tropical paradise, home to three Pete Dye golf courses including the world-famous Teeth of the Dog with seven oceanfront holes.
whats_special: Casa de Campo is the Caribbean's most exclusive resort destination, featuring its own private airport, marina, and Altos de Chavón - a stunning 16th-century Mediterranean-style artists' village with a 5,000-seat amphitheater that has hosted legends like Frank Sinatra and Sting. The resort's Teeth of the Dog golf course consistently ranks among the world's top 50 courses.
pro_tip: Book your Teeth of the Dog tee times well in advance and request an early morning slot for the best lighting and fewer crowds on those iconic oceanfront holes.
dont_miss: Sunset dinner at Altos de Chavón's cobblestone plaza overlooking the Chavón River, a romantic horseback ride on Minitas Beach, and sport fishing in the legendary waters where blue marlin tournaments have made La Romana famous worldwide.
pros: World-class golf courses including renowned Teeth of the Dog course
Extensive luxury resort amenities with multiple pools and restaurants
Beautiful Caribbean beachfront location in Dominican Republic
Spacious villa accommodations with privacy and upscale furnishings
cons: Large resort property requiring transportation between areas
Premium pricing for luxury resort experience
